data.gender_notes: Fawziah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fawziah is a feminine name that means 'victorious' or 'triumphant'. It is derived from the root word 'fawz' which means 'victory'. The name Fawziah carries the meaning “Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fawziah usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: As a spiritual name, Fawziah symbolizes the triumph of good over evil and the victory of faith over doubt.
